paragraphs: SpryPoint sells cloud software for utility customer service and operations across the meter-to-cash lifecycle. That platform is sold to water and sewer, electric, and gas utilities as a business transformation partner from meter-to-cash. SpryCIS is the customer information system at the core of that lifecycle, unifying customer service and operations.

SpryEngage is the customer portal, giving customers access to account information, billing, usage trends, and analytics. SpryWallet is payment processing built into SpryCIS and SpryEngage, and SpryMobile connects the back office to field operations. SpryBackflow covers equipment verification, testing, and regulatory compliance tracking in one place.

Testimonials on the home page come from LOGIS, Conway Corp, and Hometown Connections. A client story on the products page is attributed to a deputy city treasurer at the City of Hamilton, Canada. Other client quotes name Aurora Water Colorado, Oro Valley Utility Arizona, and Marana Arizona.

quote.text: SpryPoint is your long-term business transformation partner from meter-to-cash for water and sewer, electric, and gas utilities as you modernize to keep pace with rapid change and customer demands.
